base_declarations.description: Name and complete address of manufacturer, packer, or importer.
base_declarations.statutory_quote: The name and complete address of the manufacturer, or where the manufacturer is not the packer, the name and complete address of the manufacturer and packer, or in case of imported packages, the name and complete address of the importer.
base_declarations.penalty_provision: Section 36(1) of Legal Metrology Act, 2009 (fine up to ₹25,000 / ₹50,000 / ₹1,00,000)

base_declarations.description: Standard weight, volume, or number in standard metric SI units.
base_declarations.expected_format: Numeric value with metric units (e.g., g, kg, ml, L, N)
base_declarations.statutory_quote: The net quantity, in terms of the standard unit of weight or measure, of the commodity contained in the package or where the commodity is packed or sold by number, the number or unit or piece or pair or set which represents the quantity shall be mentioned.

base_declarations.description: MRP inclusive of all taxes in Indian Rupees.
base_declarations.expected_format: MRP Rs X.XX (incl. of all taxes) or ₹ X.XX
base_declarations.statutory_quote: The maximum retail price at which the commodity in packaged form may be sold to the consumer, inclusive of all taxes, in Indian currency (e.g. MRP Rs. / ₹ xx.xx, inclusive of all taxes).
base_declarations.penalty_provision: Section 36(1) and Section 36(2) of Legal Metrology Act, 2009

base_declarations.description: Mandatory unit sale price per gram, kilogram, millilitre, litre, or number.
base_declarations.expected_format: ₹ X.XX / g or ₹ X.XX / ml or ₹ X.XX / kg or ₹ X.XX / N
base_declarations.statutory_quote: The unit sale price shall be declared as 'Rs./₹ __ per g' for net qty < 1kg; 'Rs./₹ __ per kg' for net qty >= 1kg; 'Rs./₹ __ per ml' for net vol < 1L; 'Rs./₹ __ per litre' for net vol >= 1L; and 'Rs./₹ __ per number' for items sold by number.

base_declarations.description: Month and year of manufacture, packing, or import.
base_declarations.statutory_quote: The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or pre-packed or imported, and if a commodity may become unfit for human consumption after a period of time, the 'best before' or 'use by date, month and year' shall also be mentioned.

base_declarations.description: Helpline phone number, email address, and postal address for customer complaints.
base_declarations.statutory_quote: Every package shall bear the name, address, telephone number, and e-mail address of the person who can be contacted by the consumer in case of a complaint or query.

base_declarations.description: Country where the product was manufactured or assembled.
base_declarations.expected_format: Country name (e.g., Made in India / Country of Origin: India)
base_declarations.statutory_quote: The name of the country of origin or manufacture or assembly in case of imported products shall be mentioned on the package.

food.name: Food & Beverages
food.governing_law: FSSAI Food Safety & Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020

declarations.description: 14-digit FSSAI license number displayed along with the FSSAI logo in contrast color.
declarations.act_name: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
declarations.statutory_quote: The FSSAI logo and 14-digit license number of the food business operator shall be displayed on the label of the food package in contrast color to the background.

declarations.description: Green filled circle (veg) or brown filled triangle (non-veg) inside a square.
declarations.expected_format: Visual green dot or brown triangle logo or textual vegetarian statement
declarations.act_name: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
declarations.statutory_quote: Every package of vegetarian food shall bear a green color filled circle inside a square, and non-vegetarian food shall bear a brown color filled triangle inside a square on the principal display panel.

declarations.description: Per 100g/serving: Energy (kcal), Protein, Carbohydrate, Total Sugar, Added Sugar, Total Fat, Saturated Fat, Trans Fat, Sodium.
declarations.expected_format: Tabular format with numeric values and units
declarations.act_name: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
declarations.statutory_quote: Nutritional information per 100g or 100ml or per single serving: Energy (kcal), Protein (g), Carbohydrate (g), Total Sugars (g), Added Sugars (g), Total Fat (g), Saturated Fat (g), Trans Fat (g), and Sodium (mg).

declarations.description: Complete ingredient listing in descending order by weight or volume.
declarations.act_name: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
declarations.statutory_quote: Ingredients shall be listed in descending order of their composition by weight or volume (m/m or v/v) at the time of manufacture of the food product.

declarations.description: Allergen declaration for substances like gluten, nuts, milk, soy, eggs.
declarations.expected_format: Contains: <allergen list> or 'May contain traces of...'
declarations.act_name: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
declarations.statutory_quote: Foods containing cereals with gluten, crustacea, fish, eggs, peanuts, soybeans, milk, tree nuts shall declare allergens as 'Contains: <allergen>' or 'May contain traces of...'.

exemptions.description: Packages with net content <= 10g or 10ml are exempt from detailed nutritional information table.

cosmetics.name: Cosmetics & Personal Care
cosmetics.governing_law: Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940 / Cosmetics Rules, 2020

declarations.description: Manufacturing license number issued by state licensing authority.
declarations.expected_format: Mfg Lic No. / M.L. No. followed by alphanumeric code
declarations.act_name: Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940 & Cosmetics Rules, 2020
declarations.statutory_quote: The manufacturing licence number under which the cosmetic is manufactured, preceded by the letters 'M.L. No.' or 'Mfg. Lic. No.'.

declarations.description: Batch or lot number for traceability preceded by 'B.No.' or 'Batch No.'.
declarations.expected_format: B.No. / Batch No. / Lot No. followed by alphanumeric code
declarations.statutory_quote: A distinctive batch number, that is to say, the number by reference to which details of manufacture of the particular batch from which the substance in the container is taken are recorded, preceded by the letter 'B' or 'Batch No.' or 'B. No.'.

declarations.description: Complete list of ingredients using INCI nomenclature.
declarations.statutory_quote: The names of ingredients in the cosmetic product shall be listed in descending order of weight or volume at the time they are added, followed by those in concentrations of less than one per cent, in any order, preceded by the words 'INGREDIENTS'.

declarations.field_name: Directions for Use / How to Use
declarations.description: Instructions for safe usage and application.
declarations.expected_format: Directions for use / How to apply instructions
declarations.statutory_quote: Adequate direction for safe use, warnings, caution or special direction, if any, shall be printed on the label.

declarations.description: Applicable warning statements (e.g., 'For external use only', 'Avoid contact with eyes').
declarations.statutory_quote: Any warning or caution statements specified in the Ninth Schedule or required under these rules.

textile.name: Textiles & Apparel
textile.governing_law: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 — Garment & Textile Provisions

declarations.description: Percentage composition of each fibre type in the fabric.
declarations.statutory_quote: Fibre composition of the fabric, containing percentage of each fibre used in the commodity (e.g. 100% Cotton, 80% Cotton 20% Polyester).

declarations.description: International standard size letter (S, M, L, XL, XXL) plus body measurements in metric centimetres.
declarations.expected_format: Size letter (S/M/L/XL/XXL) with chest/waist in cm
declarations.statutory_quote: Standard sizes of garments/apparel with dimensions in metric units: S (Chest 88-93cm), M (93-99cm), L (99-105cm), XL (105-111cm), XXL (111-116cm).

declarations.description: Washing, drying, and ironing instructions or ISO symbols.
declarations.expected_format: ISO wash care symbols or textual instructions
declarations.act_name: Bureau of Indian Standards Textile Labelling
declarations.statutory_quote: Care labelling code using symbols or words for washing, bleaching, drying, and ironing.

electronics.name: Electronics & Electrical Appliances
electronics.governing_law: Legal Metrology Rules & BIS (Bureau of Indian Standards) CRO

declarations.description: BIS certification or CRS registration number (R-XXXXXXXX).
declarations.act_name: Electronics and Information Technology Goods (Compulsory Registration) Order
declarations.statutory_quote: Every electronic product notified under Compulsory Registration Scheme shall bear the Standard Mark with registration number R-XXXXXXXX.

declarations.description: Electrical input ratings: voltage, wattage, frequency.
declarations.act_name: Central Electricity Authority Regulations & BIS Safety Standards
declarations.source_document: Safety of Audio/Video, Information and Communication Technology Equipment
declarations.statutory_quote: The rated voltage or rated voltage range, nature of supply, rated frequency, and rated power input or current shall be marked on the appliance.

declarations.field_name: QR Code Declaration for Electronic Goods
declarations.description: QR code on package allowing consumers to scan for address, dimensions, and customer support details.
declarations.expected_format: Readable QR code with text: 'Scan QR code for full details'
declarations.statutory_quote: In the case of an electronic product, the package shall declare the name of manufacturer/packer/importer on the package itself and inform consumers to scan the QR code for address, generic name, size, dimensions, and customer care details.

declarations.description: Bureau of Energy Efficiency star rating label with star level, annual energy consumption (kWh/year), and validity period.
declarations.expected_format: Star rating label with 'ELECTRICITY CONSUMPTION' / 'kWh/year' and 'BEE' logo
declarations.act_name: Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) Regulations & Energy Conservation Act, 2001
declarations.source_document: BEE Star Labelling Notification & Energy Conservation Act
declarations.statutory_quote: Every appliance notified under Star Labelling Scheme shall affix the Star Label displaying the Star Level (1 to 5), Electricity Consumption in kWh/year, label period validity, brand, and model details.
declarations.penalty_provision: Section 26 of Energy Conservation Act, 2001 (penalty up to ₹10,00,000)

declarations.description: Statutory warning: 'Chewing of Pan Masala is injurious to health'.
declarations.expected_format: Chewing of Pan Masala is injurious to health
declarations.statutory_quote: Provided further that nothing contained in this clause shall apply to the packages containing pan masala having net quantity of up to ten grams.

exemptions.description: Rule 26(a) <= 10g exemption is strictly prohibited for Pan Masala by G.S.R. 881(E) dated 02.12.2025. Full declarations mandatory on all pouches.
